verdict.rationale: Rootly's docs confirm two status page types, public and private (rootly-docs-46). They also say status pages serve both internal stakeholders and external customers (rootly-docs-38), which covers the core idea of internal or private pages. The pack does not describe how access is controlled or how pages are scoped to particular audiences. missing for 10: documented access-control mechanisms (SSO/auth, allowlists, viewer management), customer-specific audience segmentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
